name: Circle Telegraph Module
goal: Turn coordinates, radius, edge width, and fade into a readable circular warning mask.

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Controls how large the telegraph area is.

internalStructure: Radius and Edge Width shape the mask.
Lerp blends ground color to warning color.
inspectNotes: Multiply demonstrates how parameters control intensity.
Lerp shows how a mask becomes a visible effect.

name: Pulse Module
goal: Convert Time into a controllable repeating intensity value.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: Controls how quickly the pulse repeats.

parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.description: Controls how strongly the pulse affects the result.

internalStructure: Add and Multiply remap from -1..1 into 0..1.
inspectNotes: The important lesson is remapping Sine output before using it as a mask.
Debug mode should show negative Sine values before remap.
